recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle, close-up photograph of the underside of a worn cowboy boot sole, featuring a circular stamped graphic, set against a blurred outdoor background with bold, blocky slab-serif typography layered across the center.
coreVisualRelationships: The boot sole acts as a vertical canvas for the secondary circular logo.
The primary text spans the horizontal midline, partially obscuring the subject.
Warm leather tones contrast against the cool greens and whites of the blurred background.
coreInvariants: Worn leather texture on the boot sole
Circular branding stamp integrated into the leather
Heavy, blocky slab-serif font with a drop shadow

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The boot is centered vertically, occupying the middle third of the frame, angled slightly toward the viewer.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The circular stamp on the upper boot sole serves as the focal point within the subject.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the large central text, moves upward to the circular stamp, and then down to the heel of the boot.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The blurred background (grass and white fence) provides breathing room around the dense central subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Earthy browns and tans (leather and wood tones) provide the organic base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Natural greens and whites in the background create depth through color contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted brick red or terracotta used for the primary display text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the foreground text against desaturated, high-key background elements.

composition.position: Top third of the boot sole
composition.warp: Perspective warp to match leather surface

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy, clean display font paired with a weathered, circular graphic emblem for a 'branded' look.
graphicDevices: Circular rope or laurel border for the stamp
Star icons as separators in the circular text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif and blunt terminals.
Provides the necessary geometric slab weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A low-angle photo of a worn cowboy boot sole facing the camera. The boot is made of distressed brown leather. The background is a soft-focus outdoor scene with green grass and a white picket fence in daylight.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, centered horizontal name in a bold, terracotta-colored slab-serif font with a dark drop shadow. On the upper part of the boot sole, add a circular 'stamped' graphic containing text and stars, warped to match the perspective and texture of the leather.

verificationChecks: Is the text color a muted terracotta?
Does the boot sole have a realistic weathered texture?
Is the background sufficiently blurred to keep focus on the boot?
Does the circular stamp look like it is physically pressed into the leather?

adjustableVariables: Thickness of the text drop shadow
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the slab serif is condensed and heavy.
Check that the circular stamp follows the curve of the boot sole.
Verify the drop shadow is consistent across all letters.
Confirm the background does not distract from the central subject.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a macro-texture subject (leather/wood) with a centered, heavy slab-serif overlay and a secondary 'branded' mark for a classic Americana aesthetic.
